title: Public Sector Banks Report Zero Locker Theft Cases in FY26; RBI Security Norms Highlighted
summary: Mandatory security upgrades eliminated physical locker breaches across state-owned lenders.

blocks.content: Mandatory security upgrades eliminated physical locker breaches across state-owned lenders.

items:
📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
PSBs reported **zero (0) locker theft cases in FY26 (2025-26)** (down from 40 cases between FY22-FY25).
Active Lockers: **11,111,077** (1.11 crore) operational lockers across PSBs as on March 31, 2026.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
**RBI Security Guidelines:** CCTV cameras mandatory at strong room entry/exit; footage preserved for **at least 180 days**.
**Bank Liability Cap:** Compensation for loss due to bank negligence capped at **100 times prevailing annual locker rent**.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Safe deposit locker rules revised under Sec 35A of Banking Regulation Act, 1949.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Bank liability for negligence (capped at 100x annual rent) vs natural calamities/Acts of God (banks NOT liable).

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "What is the compensation cap under RBI guidelines when locker loss occurs due to bank negligence?"
💡 **Model Answer: Banks are strictly liable for negligence-related losses, capped at 100 times annual locker rent.**
blocks.author: Banking & Regulatory Board Panel
